* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Jizzy.png]] [[../T-Bone Mendez/]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Jizzy.png]] Jizzy's Club, Battery Point, San Fierro
|}

After the cutscene, get in the car and follow the directions given, via the building site in Doherty, the docks at Easter Basin, then finally to the airport. 

When you get to the airport, use the meter to locate the van. At the main entrance to the airport is a gate that leads to the innermost circular road in front of the terminal.   There are underpasses that lead from this road to the tarmac.  This gate is normally locked except for this mission and until you get a pilot's license.

If you get there with plenty of time, the van is at the northeast end of the runway. Don't destroy the van, Mike is inside. Follow them, and they will eventually stop. Take them out, and T-Bone will release Toreno from the back of the van. Now destroy the van, and drive out of the airport. 

When you reach the entrance, you will be given a 3-star wanted level, and must get to the Pay 'N' Spray near the garage in Doherty.  As you drive back to the Pleasure Dome to complete the mission, Mike Toreno will check out your wallet to find out who you really are.

* '''Cash''': $7,000
